promises.target: EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030
promises.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%, very much in line with the milestones laid out under Project Spring, where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.

promises.target: north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030
promises.quote: We have given our guidance of going north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030.
Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.

reported.quote: Consolidated revenues grew by 39% year-on-year, supported by sustained momentum across both our wires and cables and FMEG businesses.
EBITDA increased by 32% year-on-year and the margins stood at 13.8%, reflecting an improvement of approximately 70 basis points sequentially over the previous quarter.
At the bottom line, we achieved our highest ever quarterly Profit After Tax of INR 7,967 million, representing a growth of 33% year-on-year.
PAT margins for the quarter came in at 9.7%.
Finance costs for the quarter were INR 800 million, while other income stood at INR 1,049 million.

Our balance sheet continues to remain strong with a net cash position of INR 39.9 billion.
The average working capital cycle improved significantly to 15 days in Quarter 1 Financial Year 2027
Capital expenditure during the quarter amounted to INR 3.2 billion, reflecting our continued commitment to building capacity and strengthening future growth drivers.
The Wires & Cables segment registered a healthy 39% year-on-year growth during the quarter.
Within this, the domestic Wires & Cables business delivered an impressive 43% year-on-year growth
EBIT margins for the Wires & Cables business stood at 13.3%.
The FMEG segment delivered another outstanding quarter, recording 71% year-on-year growth with strong contributions across all product categories.
EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%
The EPC business reported revenues of INR 3,077 million during the Quarter 1 Financial Year 2027
